variants.name: Chicken & Turkey 100 g
variants.about_this_item: Monge Grill is delicious cuts of grilled meat in a sauce. Monge Grill recipes contain the highest quality source of animal protein, selected for their nutritional properties. Recipes developed to meet the nutritional needs of dogs of different ages. Complete food for adult dogs made from selected grilled chicken and turkey meat. The grain-free recipe is enriched with glucosamine and chondroitin sulphate for joint support.
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: Meat and animal derivatives 40% (chicken 14% and turkey 14%), minerals, glucosamine 0.008%, chondroitin sulphate 0.004%.

Analytical constituents: Crude protein 9%, crude fibre 0.5%, crude fat 7%, crude ash 1.6%, moisture 78.5%.

Additives: NUTRITIONAL ADDITIVES: Vitamin D3 250 IU, Vitamin E (all-rac-alpha-tocopheryl acetate) 8 mg.
